sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Sector breadth remains narrow with only 2 of 11 groups all-green across timeframes, led by Energy's sustained dominance, while Communication Services deteriorates to the bottom of the board.

Energy (momentum 0.900, rank 1) and Healthcare (momentum 0.800, rank 3) are leading the market as the sole sectors maintaining positive returns across the week, month, quarter, half, and YTD. Technology also holds a top-tier momentum score of 0.783 at rank 2, rounding out an otherwise selective upper tier.

Rotation is subdued, with minor rank gains concentrated in lower-tier sectors like Consumer Cyclical (+1 to rank 10) and Utilities (+1 to rank 9). Meanwhile, Communication Services is actively fading, sliding 2 spots over the last 5 sessions to rank 11 with a market-low momentum score of 0.100.

## Strength
- **Narrow Breadth:** Only 2 of 11 groups are all-green across all evaluated periods: Energy (momentum 0.900) and Healthcare (momentum 0.800).
- **Sustained Leadership:** Energy is the sole sector exhibiting sustained strength, remaining in the top 3 across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons while holding the #1 YTD rank.
- **Top Momentum Tier:** Technology maintains strong performance at rank 2 with a 0.783 momentum score, followed by Consumer Defensive at rank 4 with a 0.650 score.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Marginal Bottom Gainers:** Consumer Cyclical (momentum 0.417) and Utilities (momentum 0.333) improved the most over 5 sessions, each rising +1 spot to reach ranks 10 and 9, respectively.
- **Primary Decliners:** Communication Services posted the steepest 5-session decline, dropping -2 spots to rank 11.
- **Persistent Laggards:** Weakness remains entrenched in Industrials (momentum 0.317, rank 6) and Real Estate (momentum 0.317, rank 8).

## Divergences
- **Communication Services Breakdown:** Communication Services has decoupled sharply from the broader market, dropping to rank 11 with an isolated low momentum score of 0.100.
- **Defensive vs. Cyclical Disconnect:** Consumer Defensive firmly outpaces Consumer Cyclical, holding a top-half momentum score of 0.650 (rank 4) compared to Consumer Cyclical's lagging 0.417 (rank 10).

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Broad market strength remains narrow with only 22 of 144 groups all-green, driven by dominant Energy and select Healthcare pockets while Industrials and defensive Utilities experience sharp near-term rank drops.

Energy continues to display robust multi-timeframe leadership, supported by sustained strength in Oil & Gas Integrated and top-tier momentum in Oil & Gas E&P (0.871) and Oil & Gas Drilling (0.861). At the same time, capital is rotating toward service and materials segments, highlighted by rapid 5-day surges in Rental & Leasing Services (+22 spots to rank 30) and Chemicals (+13 spots to rank 19).

Conversely, previous leaders in healthcare and defensive niches are beginning to stumble. Fading signals have appeared in Medical Distribution (momentum 0.67, falling 9 spots) and Healthcare Plans (momentum 0.61, down 8 spots), alongside steep declines across Metal Fabrication (-31 spots) and Utilities - Regulated Water (-20 spots). Bottom-tier momentum remains severely depressed in Advertising Agencies (0.036) and Solar (0.099).

## Strength
- **Narrow All-Green Breadth:** 22 of 144 groups are positive across all time horizons, led by Diagnostics & Research (momentum 0.87), Oil & Gas E&P (0.87), Marine Shipping (0.86), and REIT - Hotel & Motel (0.86).
- **Sustained Multimonth Leadership:** Oil & Gas Integrated, Health Information Services, Business Equipment & Supplies, Household & Personal Products, Insurance - Diversified, Medical Distribution, and Software - Application all maintain top-36 ranks across 1-, 3-, and 6-month windows.
- **Top Absolute Momentum:** Momentum peaks are concentrated in Diagnostics & Research (0.871, rank_ytd 24), Oil & Gas E&P (0.871, rank_ytd 10), and Marine Shipping (0.865, rank_ytd 5).

## Movers & Momentum
- **Fastest Gainers:** Rental & Leasing Services surged 22 spots to rank 30 (momentum 0.81), followed by Security & Protection Services (+16 spots to rank 55, momentum 0.71) and REIT - Specialty (+14 spots to rank 50, momentum 0.59).
- **Sharpest Declines:** Metal Fabrication cratered 31 spots to rank 84 (momentum 0.21), Utilities - Regulated Water shed 20 spots to rank 71 (momentum 0.39), and Biotechnology lost 17 spots to rank 60 (momentum 0.60).
- **Persistent Laggards:** Weakness is anchored by Advertising Agencies (momentum 0.036, rank_ytd 144), Resorts & Casinos (momentum 0.093, rank_ytd 138), and Solar (momentum 0.099, rank_ytd 140).

## Divergences
- **Fading Momentum:** High-momentum groups showing near-term rank erosion include Medical Distribution (momentum 0.67, -9 spots), Healthcare Plans (momentum 0.61, -8 spots), and Insurance - Reinsurance (momentum 0.65, -7 spots).
- **Emerging Turnarounds:** Beaten-down industries posting fast 5-day rank gains despite low momentum scores include REIT - Retail (+9 spots, momentum 0.48), REIT - Office (+8 spots, momentum 0.39), and Engineering & Construction (+7 spots, momentum 0.33).
